_comment: The differential corpus for engine/sim.py (ROADMAP step 2): one parked
state and ONE measured action per drive. `writes` are transparent RAM
edits applied after the reload (type, hp, ammo, fuel, capture, state,
terrain, army fields, settings -- never a position); `setup` steps are
driven and verified but not measured (a `write` step edits RAM between
driven steps); `action` is what tools/sim_diff.py applies in Python and
diffs against the game's after-dump. Slots: P1 = 1..63, P2 = 65..127.
RAM types are written by name; `meter: threshold` is the CO's cost.
Both states share the 15x10 map: P1 HQ (0,8), P2 HQ (14,1), cities
(4,1) (5,1) (11,2) (3,8) (9,9) (10,9); row 5 is river with bridges at
x=1,7,13; roads down column 1, along row 2, column 7, row 7, column 13.
vs15_p2: P2 to move. Tank71 (9,7) road, APC69 (12,7) carrying Inf66,
Recon70 (14,2), Mech67 (13,4), Mech68 (11,3) under the neutral city,
Inf65 (8,4) acted, Art72 (14,4); P1's Mech3 (7,6) road, Inf2 (6,3),
a15_p1: P1 to move. Inf2 (4,2) south of the neutral city (4,1), Tank7
